## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- ANA LUX planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 48.7M€2022, of which 39.6% relates to new major investments. ANA LUX planned 1 new major investment for RP4, which has not started yet.

- According to the reporting tables, ANA LUX overspent +0.1M€2022 (+5.1%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- ANA LUX reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
